templates.name: vm

resource.manifest:
apiVersion: kubevirt.io/v1
kind: VirtualMachineInstance
metadata:
  name: "{{workflow.name}}-amd64"
  labels:
    oberth.ci/workflow: "{{workflow.name}}"
spec:
  architecture: amd64
  domain:
    cpu:
      cores: 2
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 2Gi
    devices:
      disks:
        - name: root
          disk:
            bus: virtio
        - name: init
          disk:
            bus: virtio
      interfaces:
        - name: default
          masquerade: {}
  networks:
    - name: default
      pod: {}
  volumes:
    - name: root
      containerDisk:
        image: quay.io/example/disk@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    - name: init
      cloudInitNoCloud:
        userData: "#cloud-config"
